label: Microsoft 365
description: Official Microsoft 365 OAuth account connections for Outlook, Calendar, OneDrive, and Teams.

apps.label: Outlook
apps.description: List and send Outlook email through Microsoft 365.

apps.label: Calendar
apps.description: List and create Microsoft 365 calendar events.

apps.label: OneDrive
apps.description: Browse files and folders in the connected OneDrive.

apps.label: Teams
apps.description: List chats and send Microsoft Teams messages.

connectPrompt: Connect Microsoft 365 to work with Outlook mail, calendars, OneDrive files, and Teams chats.

tools.name: microsoft_365_outlook_list_messages
tools.description: List Outlook messages from the connected mailbox. When multiple Outlook accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

folder_id.description: Optional mail folder ID, default inbox.

account_email.description: Optional connected Outlook account email or identifier.

tools.name: microsoft_365_outlook_send_mail
tools.description: Send an Outlook email from the connected mailbox. When multiple Outlook accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

save_to_sent_items.description: Whether to save to Sent Items, default true.

account_email.description: Optional connected Outlook account email or identifier.

tools.name: microsoft_365_calendar_list_events
tools.description: List Microsoft 365 calendar events. When start is supplied, only events whose real start is at or after start (and before end when present) are returned by default. Set include_ongoing=true to include events that began earlier but still overlap, or include_all_day=true for all-day entries. Keep both false for upcoming-event reminders. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

include_ongoing.description: Include events that began before start and are still running. Defaults to false for bounded windows.

include_all_day.description: Include all-day and multi-day date events. Defaults to false for bounded windows.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: microsoft_365_calendar_create_event
tools.description: Create a Microsoft 365 calendar event. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: microsoft_365_onedrive_list_children
tools.description: List OneDrive children under root or a drive item. When multiple OneDrive accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

item_id.description: Optional drive item ID. Omit for root.

account_email.description: Optional connected OneDrive account email or identifier.

tools.name: microsoft_365_teams_list_chats
tools.description: List Microsoft Teams chats visible to the connected user. When multiple Teams accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Teams account email or identifier.

tools.name: microsoft_365_teams_list_chat_messages
tools.description: List the newest messages in a Microsoft Teams chat. When multiple Teams accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Teams account email or identifier.

tools.name: microsoft_365_teams_send_chat_message
tools.description: Send a Microsoft Teams chat message. When multiple Teams accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Teams account email or identifier.

tools.name: microsoft_365_outlook_graph_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Microsoft Graph API request for advanced Outlook operations. When multiple Outlook accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

account_email.description: Optional connected Outlook account email or identifier.

tools.name: microsoft_365_calendar_graph_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Microsoft Graph API request for advanced Calendar operations. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: microsoft_365_onedrive_graph_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Microsoft Graph API request for advanced OneDrive operations. When multiple OneDrive accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

account_email.description: Optional connected OneDrive account email or identifier.

tools.name: microsoft_365_teams_graph_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Microsoft Graph API request for advanced Teams operations. When multiple Teams accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

account_email.description: Optional connected Teams account email or identifier.
